title: TRICARE Retired Reserve Recall Month Relief: Amount Withdrawn per Day
content:
Under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, for a TRICARE Retired Reserve plan, the daily amount the recall month relief withdraws follows what was paid on the monthly bill: where no payment stands against it, it is the amount billed divided by the days the bill covers; where a payment covers only part of it, it is the part still unpaid divided by those days; otherwise nothing is withdrawn, the paid month being credited back with the Retired Reserve closing reconciliation instead.

The monthly bill is the bill of the latest-billed month (the coverage month of the plan's monthly bill with the latest due date); the amount billed is the monthly premium billed for that month, the days are the days that bill covers, and the payment is what is posted against that bill.

**Cases (hypothetical: June bill of 614.07 covering 30 days).**

- No payment against it: 614.07 divided by 30, 20.4690 a day.
- 300.00 paid against it: the unpaid 314.07 divided by 30, 10.4690 a day.
- 614.07 paid: nothing is withdrawn.
